name: site-map-return
description: Leaving a live site through the TopBar map button and coming back via the world map's back-to-site button resumes the same game: tick and cash are untouched and the world map closes (#1314).

steps.description: Player opens the site map from the TopBar; the world map must offer a way back to the live site. 'state' is the paired command for this UI-only step.

expect.note: opening the map from a live site must not touch the simulation

steps.description: Player clicks back-to-site; the world map closes and the same game continues untouched.

expect.note: no restart: tick and cash unchanged, map hidden
